summary: Iteration 3 verifies the AUTH FIX (cookie -> Authorization: Bearer header). All 32/32 backend tests pass using Bearer token in session header (cookies cleared from session before each test). Frontend smoke-tested all 5 roles: login stores token in localStorage 'honeybee_token', role-specific dashboards load, logout clears token and protected routes redirect to /login. Patient booking creates a real appointment (verified via /api/appointments), therapist save-notes completes an appointment, manager KPIs + 6 recharts render, admin portal lists 14 users with role badges.

minor.issue: Token (JWT) is returned in response body for Bearer auth, but the access_token httpOnly cookie is also still set with samesite=none/secure=true. Two parallel auth mechanisms — works correctly, but worth picking one for clarity post-MVP.
Permissive CORS regex remains. Bearer header path is unaffected (no preflight credential constraint hit) so functionally fine; tighten in prod.
Existing edge case from iter 1 still present: < date+T23:59:59 boundary. Cosmetic.

issues: Recharts logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on first render before container measures. Charts still render correctly after first paint.

action_items: Optional cleanup: pick a single auth mechanism (Bearer header OR cookie) and remove the other to reduce surface area. The Bearer header is the right primary choice given the ingress CORS override.
Optional hardening: replace allow_origin_regex='.*' with explicit origin list when allow_credentials is kept.
Optional: silence Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings by giving ResponsiveContainer parents an explicit min-height.
critical_code_review_comments: axios interceptor (frontend/src/lib/api.js) correctly reads localStorage('honeybee_token') and attaches Authorization: Bearer. withCredentials removed as expected.
Backend get_current_user is presumed to accept both cookie and Authorization Bearer (verified by 32/32 passing with cookies cleared). Keep both decoders in one helper.
server.py still ~900 lines; recommend modularising (auth/, appointments/, payments/, admin/) for maintainability — repeat of iter 1 note.
All previously flagged RBAC issues from iter 1 (patient listing therapists, PATCH appointment guard) are now passing (test_patient_can_list_therapists + test_patient_cannot_mark_completed both PASS).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (switched _login helper to use Authorization: Bearer header and clear cookies; added test_bearer_token_works_without_cookie and test_missing_auth_returns_401; assert token in login/register response body)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all 5 dashboards load, all spec-required data-testid selectors functional, patient booking persists, therapist completes appt, admin user table populated, logout flow works)

test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md verified — all 9 demo accounts login successfully.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed users and appointments during testing. Booked one new appointment for Hugo on 2026-06-11T10:30 via the patient UI; this can be safely left in the DB or cleaned later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth-fix verification complete. Both Authorization: Bearer header AND access_token cookie work; backend_test.py now exercises ONLY the Bearer path (cookies are cleared from session right after login). If the main agent later removes cookie auth, no test changes needed. Stripe e2e (test_stripe_e2e.py) was not re-run this iteration — only backend_test.py's TestStripe.test_create_checkout_session + test_payment_status (both PASS).
rca of the issue: Root cause (resolved): ingress (Cloudflare) overrode Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*' while backend kept allow_credentials=true, so browsers refused to attach the httpOnly cookie on cross-origin XHRs. FIX VERIFIED: backend returns token in login/register response body; frontend stores in localStorage 'honeybee_token' and sends via Authorization: Bearer through axios interceptor. Cookie still set as a fallback but no longer required for the UI auth path. Verified end-to-end across all 5 roles.
